description: This is a source file implementing a library of APIs for sending, receiving, parsing, and handling system events via a daemon using stream protocols. It includes message construction, parsing, header management, and debug/print utilities.

methods.name: unsigned int align(unsigned int value)
methods.description: Aligns an integer value on a 4-byte boundary, used internally for message size calculations.

methods.name: void init_libsysevent(const char * const name)
methods.description: Initializes the sysevent library with a given name for logging and identification.

methods.name: int msg_receive_internal(int fd,char * replymsg,unsigned int * replymsg_size,token_t * who,struct timeval * wait,int * error)
methods.description: Internal function to receive a message from a socket, handling select and partial reads, returning message type.

methods.name: unsigned int SE_string2size(const char * str)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to encode a string into a sysevent message, including alignment.

methods.name: int SE_msg_add_string(char * msg,unsigned int size,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a null-terminated string to a message buffer with size prefix and alignment.

methods.name: int SE_msg_add_data(char * msg,unsigned int size,const char * data,const int data_length)
methods.description: Adds raw data to a message buffer with size prefix, used for binary content.

methods.name: char * SE_msg_get_data(char * msg,int * size)
methods.description: Retrieves data from a message buffer, returning a pointer to the data and setting size.

methods.name: char * SE_msg_get_string(char * msg,int * size)
methods.description: Retrieves a string from a message buffer, handling size decoding and pointer arithmetic.

methods.name: char * mtype2str(int mtype)
methods.description: Converts a message type integer to its string representation for debugging.

methods.name: int SE_print_message(char * inmsg,int type)
methods.description: Prints a human-readable representation of a message based on its type.

methods.name: int SE_print_message_hdr(char * inhdr)
methods.description: Prints message header and calls message printing for detailed content.

methods.name: int SE_msg_hdr_mbytes_fixup(se_msg_hdr * hdr)
methods.description: Calculates the total message size and updates the message header's mbytes field.

methods.name: char * SE_msg_prepare(char * buf,const unsigned int bufsize,const int mtype,const token_t sender)
methods.description: Prepares a message header for sending by setting delimeter, size, and type fields.

methods.name: int SE_msg_receive(int fd,char * replymsg,unsigned int * replymsg_size,token_t * who)
methods.description: Receives a complete message from a socket, blocking until a message is received.

methods.name: int SE_minimal_blocking_msg_receive(int fd,char * replymsg,unsigned int * replymsg_size,token_t * who)
methods.description: Attempts to receive a message non-blockingly with a short timeout, returning if no message is available.

methods.name: int SE_msg_send(int fd,char * sendmsg)
methods.description: Sends a constructed message buffer over a socket, adding footer/trailer for integrity.

methods.name: int connect_to_local_sysevent_daemon(char * target,int * sockfd)
methods.description: Establishes a Unix domain socket connection to the local sysevent daemon, with retries.

methods.name: int connect_to_sysevent_daemon(char * ip,unsigned short port,int * sockfd)
methods.description: Establishes a network socket connection (IPv4/IPv6 or UDS fallback) to the sysevent daemon, with retries and fallback to UDS if loopback is detected.

methods.name: int sysevent_open(char * ip,unsigned short port,int version,char * id,token_t * token)
methods.description: Connects to the sysevent daemon over network, performs registration, and returns a socket descriptor or error.

methods.name: int sysevent_open_data(char * ip,unsigned short port,int version,char * id,token_t * token)
methods.description: Similar to sysevent_open, but for data registration, with response handling.

methods.name: int sysevent_local_open(char * target,int version,char * id,token_t * token)
methods.description: Connects to the sysevent daemon via Unix domain socket, performs registration, and returns a socket descriptor or error.

methods.name: int sysevent_close(int fd,token_t token)
methods.description: Closes a sysevent connection by sending a close message and closing the socket.

methods.name: int sysevent_ping(int fd,token_t token)
methods.description: Sends a ping message to the daemon to check connection health.

methods.name: int sysevent_ping_test(int fd,token_t token,struct timeval * tv)
methods.description: Performs a ping and waits for a reply within a specified timeout.

methods.name: int sysevent_debug(char * ip,unsigned short port,int level)
methods.description: Sets the debug level on the sysevent daemon.

methods.name: int sysevent_get(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * inbuf,char * outbuf,int outbytes)
methods.description: Sends a get request for a string key and retrieves its value.

methods.name: int sysevent_get_data(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * inbuf,char * outbuf,int outbytes,int * bufsizecopied)
methods.description: Sends a get request for a key and retrieves associated binary data.

methods.name: int sysevent_set(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,const char * value,int conf_req)
methods.description: Sets a string key-value pair in the sysevent daemon.

methods.name: int sysevent_set_data(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,const char * value,int value_length)
methods.description: Sets binary data for a key in the sysevent daemon.

methods.name: int sysevent_unset(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name)
methods.description: Removes a key (tuple) from the sysevent daemon.

methods.name: int sysevent_set_with_tid(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,const char * value,const int source,const int tid)
methods.description: Sets a key-value with source and transaction id.

methods.name: int sysevent_set_unique(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,const char * value,char * outbuf,int outbytes)
methods.description: Creates a new unique tuple with a generated name, returns the name.

methods.name: int sysevent_get_unique(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * inbuf,unsigned int * iterator,char * subjectbuf,int subjectbytes,char * valuebuf,int valuebytes)
methods.description: Retrieves a unique tuple's name and value matching certain criteria.

methods.name: unsigned int sysevent_get_binmsg_maxsize()
methods.description: Reads the maximum binary message size from a config file, with fallback.

methods.name: int sysevent_del_unique(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,unsigned int * iterator)
methods.description: Send a delete of unique element from its namespace.

methods.name: int sysevent_get_next_iterator(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,unsigned int * iterator)
methods.description: Get the next iterator for a namespace.

methods.name: int sysevent_set_options(const int fd,const token_t token,const char * name,const unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Send a set options to the sysevent daemon to change tuple flags.

methods.name: int sysevent_setcallback(const int fd,const token_t token,action_flag_t flags,char * subject,char * function,int numparams,char ** params,async_id_t * async_id)
methods.description: Declare a callback/executable to run when a tuple changes value.

methods.name: int sysevent_setnotification(const int fd,const token_t token,char * subject,async_id_t * async_id)
methods.description: Request a notification message to be sent when a tuple changes value.

methods.description: Remove a notification callback from a trigger.
